title: Slime Helper
subtitle: VS Code Extension — Coding Buddy
description: Slime helper is a VS Code extension that keeps track of your git, error messages and overall coding. It's also designed with animations and a personality as it keeps you company while coding.
longDescription: Slime Helper is an interactive companion extension for Visual Studio Code, built to make software development more engaging and dynamic. The extension listens to internal VS Code events—such as Git commits and diagnostic error messages—and reacts with playful animations and encouraging feedback right inside the editor.
highlights: Published on the official Visual Studio Code Marketplace
Event-driven integration with the VS Code Extension API and Git events
Animated desktop companion reacting to real-time coding events

title: Christmas Gift Game
subtitle: Gift Exchange Game in .NET MAUI
description: A Christmas gift exchange game I developed while learning .NET MAUI and XAML/XML. The app is fully functional and features a user-friendly interface.
longDescription: A digital Christmas gift exchange game built with the cross-platform framework .NET MAUI and XAML. The application manages gameplay logic for dice rolls, turn countdowns, gift trades, and steals according to traditional gift game rules, packaged in a smooth and intuitive user interface.
highlights: Built using a modern cross-platform architecture in .NET MAUI and C#
Reactive UI with XAML data binding and robust state management
Timed rounds and interactive gift exchange game mechanics

title: Restaurant Management
subtitle: OOP Management Software
description: Console application developed during my OOP/C# course. It is a restaurant management software focusing on personnel, orders, and resource management.
longDescription: A comprehensive console application in C# built to simulate restaurant operations and resource management. The system leverages object-oriented design patterns to manage staff schedules, customer orders, table reservations, and menu registries.
highlights: Clean object-oriented architecture (OOP) utilizing inheritance and polymorphism
Structured data handling and console-based menu navigation
Input validation and exception handling for a stable user experience

title: Portfolio SPA
subtitle: Modern React & Vite Portfolio
description: The site you are currently visiting, built as a single-page application featuring modern HUD glassmorphism and custom cyber aesthetics.
longDescription: My personal portfolio website built with React 19, Vite, and Tailwind CSS v4. Designed with a futuristic HUD-inspired visual language, frosted glass effects (backdrop-blur), custom SVG illustrations, and dynamic routing for comprehensive project documentation.
highlights: Custom design built with Tailwind CSS v4 and glassmorphism styling
Dynamic ID-based routing for in-depth project documentation
Fully responsive and optimized for fast load times and performance
